product.title: Giant's Causeway Day Tour from Dublin

description.text: Leave Dublin on a 13-hour day to Giant's Causeway, with stops at the Dark Hedges and Dunluce Castle on County Antrim's coast. A guide covers geology and folklore while the coach handles the long northbound drive from the city. Dunluce Castle admission is included; UNESCO Giant's Causeway access is a public monument. Meet at the Molly Malone statue on Suffolk Street. The outing is built for visitors who want Antrim coast columns and castle ruins without self-driving from Dublin. Stops include Giant's Causeway, Dark Hedges, Dunluce Castle.
